sprint: BACKLOG.md Batch 2 -- Bug G (Curve text) -- Story Author can arc/curve any Text object end to end (World Builder v2 Text Experience + Story-owned freeform text + World-owned text quick-edit; both engines kept in lockstep)
task: Closes Batch 2 (Bug G) of the 5-batch BACKLOG plan. BACKLOG bug verbatim: 'For texts allow these curves' (screenshot of arc-shaped text). This ship covers the Studio (root) side: Story-owned freeform text sticker gains a Curve control in js/contextPanel.js's _appendStickerTextEditControl (paired with the existing Spin/Rotation control via _pairRow), writing st.curve via SceneEngine.updateSticker's generic shallow-merge (the same write path Spin already uses -- text stickers own their own top-level fields, unlike World-owned text objects which use setContentOverride). The World-owned Text quick-edit popup's Curve control was already shipped in a prior turn of this same effort (via setContentOverride slide/sceneObj.id/'curve'); renderer/slideRenderer.js's _drawFreeformText (line 4328) and _layerDrawText (line 1726, ov.curve || t.curve || 0) already read curve; _drawCurvedTextLine (line 2927) already implements the per-character arc math (radius = textWidth / |arcRad|; per-char position and rotation derived from the character's own midpoint offset from center). Verified 20/20 assertions via batch2_bug_g_verify.js: (P1, World Builder v2) schema (textCurve:0 default in defaultUniversalContent + PART_FIELD_KEYS.text), Engine Adapter (mirrored Scene Layer's .curve === 60 for a real 60 degree authored value), and Inspector source-level check (_buildFieldGroup('Curve', _range(-180, 180, props.textCurve, ...))); (P2, Publish Fidelity, Creator Governing Rule #5) real ProjectCompiler build compiles text.curve === 60 through to the .vtheme package; (P3, root Studio real Reader-facing renderer) SlideRenderer.render(s) with a compiled text Layer Pack entry (anchor:'top-center' + rect:{x:0.1,y:0.3,w:0.8,h:0.4}, the exact shape builder.js's convergeSceneLayer produces) draws real curved text with a bowed baseline (curved range 82px vs straight range within sampling-noise band, curved > straight + 10px margin, both draw real ink); (P4) contextPanel.js source-level check for BOTH World-owned Text setContentOverride('curve') AND Story-owned freeform update({curve}) controls reachable. Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) PASS unchanged. Batches 3-5 (F+A, H, C) remain queued.
